programme.title: 15 Minutos
programme.desc: Eddie Flemming é um detetive do departamento de homicídios que se une a Jordy Warsaw, um especialista do corpo de bombeiros, para tentar capturar uma dupla de criminosos do leste europeu que gravam os assassínios que cometem para se tornarem ricos e famosos.

programme.title: Peppermint
programme.desc: Riley North acorda de um coma após o assassinato do seu marido e da sua filha num brutal ataque à sua família. Quando o sistema protege os assassinos da justiça, Riley transforma-se numa verdadeira guerrilheira urbana, aplicando de forma metódica a sua forma muito pessoal de justiça.

programme.title: Resposta Armada
programme.desc: Uma equipa de agentes altamente treinada e liderada por Isaac vê-se encurralada num complexo militar isolado e começa a ser alvo de fenómenos estranhos à medida que tenta descobrir quem matou a equipa anterior que ela lá foi resgatar.

programme.title: Noite Violenta
programme.desc: Quando uma equipa de mercenários invade a mansão de uma família rica na véspera de Natal, tornando reféns os seus membros, o grupo não está preparado para um combatente surpresa: o Pai Natal está lá em casa e prepara-se para mostrar que Nicolau não é santo nenhum.

programme.title: Butcher's Crossing: Cruzamento Do Carniceiro
programme.desc: Em 1874, Will Andrews deixa a faculdade de Harvard rumo a Butcher’s Crossing, uma cidadezinha do Kansas, para se juntar a uma equipa de caçadores de bisontes. Mas a visão romântica que tinha da tarefa vai sofrer um duro revés quando a sua vida e a sua sanidade vão ser colocadas seriamente em risco.

programme.title: O Amor E A Vida Real
programme.desc: Dan Burns é um colunista, especialista em aconselhamento familiar, mas com dificuldade em sobreviver como irmão e como pai viúvo de três filhas precoces. As coisas tornam-se ainda mais complicadas quando Dan descobre que a sua apaixonada secreta é na realidade a nova namorada do irmão…

programme.title: Um Polícia No Jardim Escola
programme.desc: John Kimble é um polícia de Los Angeles que tem de se infiltrar numa comunidade como professor de um jardim infantil para localizar a ex-mulher do perigoso criminoso que ele quer colocar atrás das grades.

programme.title: Uma Casa Cheia
programme.desc: Alice Kinney vive em Los Angeles com as duas filhas. Com 40 anos e solteira, ela vai ver a sua vida sofrer uma grande reviravolta quando, a pedido da mãe, consente que três jovens atraentes vão viver temporariamente em sua casa.

programme.title: DC Liga Dos Super Pets
programme.desc: Quando o Super-Homem e o resto da Liga da Justiça são raptados, Krypto tenta convencer os animais abandonados de um canil – Ace o cão de caça, PB a porca, Merton a tartaruga e Chip o esquilo – a dominarem os seus recentes superpoderes e a ajudá-lo a salvar os super-heróis em apuros.

programme.title: Novos Amigos Improváveis
programme.desc: Phillip é um homem rico e tetraplégico e Dell é um desempregado com cadastro criminal que é contratado para o ajudar. Apesar da relação inicial tensa, os dois acabam por forjar uma inesperada amizade, que mudará a via de ambos.

programme.title: Moonfall Rota De Colisão
programme.desc: Uma força misteriosa tira a Lua da sua órbita em torno da Terra e envia-a numa rota de colisão capaz de aniquilar a vida como a conhecemos. Semanas antes do impacto, três heróis improváveis vão lançar-se numa última missão no espaço, e descobrem que a nossa Lua não é o que pensávamos que era.

programme.title: Mile 22
programme.desc: Uma pequena equipa de elite de oficiais americanos, parte de uma unidade operações especiais e secretas, tem por missão levar para fora da Indonésia um misterioso agente da polícia com informações sensíveis.

programme.title: Kickboxer III
programme.desc: David Sloane viaja para o Rio de Janeiro para um evento de kickboxing, onde acaba por salvar dois jovens e enfrentar um traficante de esclavos.

programme.title: Impacto Súbito
programme.desc: Quando uma mulher exerce uma vingança mortal nos agressores que a violaram e à irmã 10 anos antes, matando-os um a um, o inspetor 'Dirty' Harry Callahan é chamado para investigar e resolver o caso.

programme.title: Noite Violenta
programme.desc: Quando uma equipa de mercenários invade a mansão de uma família rica na véspera de Natal, tornando reféns os seus membros, o grupo não está preparado para um combatente surpresa: o Pai Natal está lá em casa e prepara-se para mostrar que Nicolau não é santo nenhum.

programme.title: Morte Em Tombstone
programme.desc: Numa disputa pelo poder, o líder de um bando de malfeitores acaba assassinado e, quando é sentenciado à eternidade no Inferno, aceita uma proposta ousada de Satanás: entregar as seis almas do seu antigo bando e libertar-se da condenação.

programme.title: Rupture: Superando O Medo
programme.desc: Renée Morgan é uma mãe solteira que tenta libertar-se a todo o custo da organização misteriosa que a raptou e mantém presa e que a usa como cobaia de horríveis experiências.

programme.title: Como Matar E Ganhar
programme.desc: Após um acidente de viação fatal, Michel foge do local e quando lá regressa com a mulher para tentar encobrir o incidente e esconder as vítimas, encontra dois milhões de euros num saco, o que dá origem a uma série de acontecimentos caóticos.

programme.title: Está Tudo Louco!
programme.desc: Um magnata jogador decide criar um novo veículo para apostas a dinheiro: uma corrida de mais de 900 quilómetros, de um casino de Las Vegas até uma estação de comboio no Novo México, onde se encontra um saco com dois milhões de dólares, que ficará para quem lá chegar primeiro.

programme.title: Fora De Controlo
programme.desc: Thomas Craven é um veterano da polícia que investiga o homicídio da própria filha, na sequência do qual descobre uma conspiração empresarial e governamental de proporções inesperadas.

programme.title: Sentido Único
programme.desc: Freddy é um pequeno criminoso em fuga com um saco cheio de dinheiro e cocaína. Ainda por cima, está gravemente ferido e tenta sobreviver a bordo de um autocarro, contra tudo e contra todos.

programme.title: O Informador
programme.desc: Peter Koslow é um ex-soldado das Operações Especiais que é recrutado pelo FBI para se tornar informador e derrubar o maior senhor do crime de Nova Iorque. Quando a operação corre mal, ele fica preso entre a máfia, a polícia e o FBI — e terá de escapar para salvar a sua família.

Quando uma arma ultrassecreta cai em mãos erradas, a agente da CIA Mason “Mace” Brown terá de unir forças com a sua rival Marie, com a antiga aliada do MI6 Khadijah e ainda com a hábil psicóloga colombiana Graciela, numa perigosa missão na qual terão de enfrentar a misteriosa Lin Mi Sheng.

programme.title: A Linha Do Horizonte
programme.desc: O piloto de um pequeno avião tem um ataque cardíaco em pleno voo rumo a uma ilha tropical. Para salvarem as suas vidas, Sara e Jackson, um casal de ex-namorados, terão de conseguir manter a aeronave no ar e encontrar o caminho de regresso a terra…

programme.title: Segundo Ato
programme.desc: Maya trabalha há 15 anos numa loja onde, apesar dos seus méritos, é preterida numa promoção com a desculpa de que não é licenciada. Sem nada a perder, resolve apostar tudo num alto cargo executivo, com um currículo inventado, provando que nunca é tarde para um segundo ato…

programme.title: Big Game Instinto Caçador
programme.desc: Nas florestas da Finlândia, um jovem de 13 anos descobre uma cápsula de salvação do Air Force One. O homem ferido à sua frente é o Presidente dos EUA, e há um grupo de terroristas a caminho para tentar raptá-lo. Agora vão ter de agir em equipa para sobreviver à noite mais perigosa das suas vidas.

programme.title: Morte Em Tombstone
programme.desc: Numa disputa pelo poder, o líder de um bando de malfeitores acaba assassinado e, quando é sentenciado à eternidade no Inferno, aceita uma proposta ousada de Satanás: entregar as seis almas do seu antigo bando e libertar-se da condenação.

programme.title: 15 Minutos
programme.desc: Eddie Flemming é um detetive do departamento de homicídios que se une a Jordy Warsaw, um especialista do corpo de bombeiros, para tentar capturar uma dupla de criminosos do leste europeu que gravam os assassínios que cometem para se tornarem ricos e famosos.

programme.title: Toro
programme.desc: Dois irmãos reencontram-se ao fim de dois anos: um deles tem estado preso, o outro roubou um perigoso recetador e agora estão ambos em fuga, juntamente com Diana, a filha menor do último, numa viagem pela Andaluzia violenta, mítica, agreste e selvagem.

programme.title: Liszt’s Concerto No. 1 And Mahler’s Symphony No. 5
programme.desc: American ‘Conductor Laureate’ Michael Tilson Thomas leads the London Symphony Orchestra in a program of romantic masterworks. The concert opens with Franz Liszt’s Piano Concerto No. 1, featuring the brilliant Czech pianist Lukáš Vondrácek as soloist. The evening concludes with the emotional journey of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 5. This performance was recorded at the Barbican Hall in London, UK, on May 15, 2022.

programme.title: Mozart, Mendelssohn And Gershwin for 2 Pianos
programme.desc: Italian pianists Roberto Prosseda and Alessandra Ammara perform W. A. Mozart's Sonata for two pianos in D major, K. 488, Felix Mendelssohn's Sonata for two pianos in D major, MWV S 1, and George Gershwin's Rhapsody in Blue, during an off-season concert recorded at Fazioli Concert Hall in Sacile, Italy in June 26, 2020.

programme.title: Modena - City of Belcanto
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Glass - A Descent into the Maelström
programme.desc: ‘A Descent into the Maelström’ (1841) is American writer Edgar Allan Poe’s short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, inside the Arctic Circle of northern Norway. After a treacherous whirlpool drags their boat down, only one of them survives. American composer Philipp Glass based his choral work for the Australian Dance Theatre on this story.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasiestücke, Op. 12
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Fantasiestücke, Op. 12. Written in 1837, the work is a set of eight piano pieces with contrasting moods.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: IVC 2019 - Final: Duparc, Borodin et al.
programme.desc: Mezzo-soprano Esther Valentin (Germany, 1993) and pianist Anastasia Grishutina (Russia, 1988) perform Henri Duparc’s L’invitation au voyage; Aleksandr Borodin’s ‘Dlya beregov otchizni dal’noy’ (For the shores of thy far native land); ‘Fleur jetée’ from Gabriel Fauré’s Quatre melodies, Op. 39; Franz Schubert’s Die Liebe hat gelogen, Op. 23 No. 1 (D.

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 34, KV. 338
programme.desc: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a remarkable concert program of works by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and Antonín Dvorák. Mozart’s Symphony No. 34 in C major, K. 338 opens the program. Completed in the summer of 1780, this was the last symphony Mozart wrote in Salzburg, where he worked as a court musician.

programme.title: Grieg's Piano Concerto And Beethoven Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in this concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016. The program opens with Felix Mendelssohn’s concert overture Die Hebriden, Op. 26 (The Hebrides). During a trip to Scotland, the composer was deeply impressed by the natural splendor of Staffa, an island of the Inner Hebrides, which inspired him to compose his concert overture.

programme.title: Dupré - Variations on Two Themes, Op. 35
programme.desc: Italian pianist Alessandro Marangoni and Italian organist Paolo Oreni perform Marcel Dupré’s Variations on Two Themes for piano and organ, Op. 35. Designed by the organist himself, Oreni plays his ‘Wanderer’ organ in this performance, which is currently the largest existing transportable pipe organ. With its 1200 pipes and 42 stops, it has all the essential timbres needed for the organ repertoire.

programme.title: The Three Lives of Clara Schumann
programme.desc: The documentary “The Three Lives of Clara Schumann” traces the fascinating life story of German pianist and composer Clara Schumann. Born Clara Wieck in Leipzig in 1819, she was an exceptionally talented pianist, with an impressive international music career. She first met Robert Schumann, whom she married in 1840 and eventually had eight children with, in 1828.

programme.title: Schumann - Humoreske, Op. 20
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz performs Humoreske in B-flat major, Op. 20. Schumann composed the work in 1839 and dedicated it to German-Austrian composer Julie von Webenau. The piece’s title refers to humor as an emotional state.

programme.title: Handel - Messiah, HWV 56
programme.desc: The Messiah (HWV 56) by Georg Frederich Handel, also known as “A New Sacred Oratorio”, tells the life and suffering of Christ: a story of passion, fire, and sacrifice. This is one of Handel's best-known works, which took only three weeks to compose this oratorio and its famous 'Hallelujah'. The work has immense popularity since its premiere in Dublin in 1742, and is often presented at Easter.

programme.title: The Pianists Keys
programme.desc: This documentary by Christoph Keller follows various participants and teachers participating in the International Summer Piano Academy.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor, Op. 37. Russian-born pianist Maya Oganyan (*2005) makes her solo debut with the orchestra. Beethoven composed this concerto in 1800 and played the piano part himself at the piece’s premiere in 1803. Like two of his other major works –Symphony No. 5 and Piano Sonata No.

programme.title: Schumann - Novelletten, Op. 21
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Novelletten, Op. 21. The eight pieces for piano that make up this song cycle are often performed separately. It bears a dedication to pianist Adolph Henselt.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 2
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: The Gustav Mahler Jugendorchester was founded in 1986 at the initiative of Claudio Abbado and has since become the world’s best youth orchestra. Named after the great composer, the programme is marked by the special relationship between the maestro and the young orchestra, as well as their special relationship to Gustav Mahler.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 8
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 8, also known as the 'Symphony of a Thousand,' is a monumental choral epic composed in 1906 that requires an enormous ensemble of soloists, choruses, and a massive orchestra to perform its vast musical tapestry. The work is a unique and grandiose tribute to love and the spiritual salvation of mankind, drawing from two distinct textual sources to create its sublime effect.

programme.title: Walton's Viola Concerto And Brahms's Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: British conductor Robin Ticciati conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of William Walton’s Viola Concerto and Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 4 in E minor, Op. 98. When the young Walton premiered his Viola Concerto in 1927, it caused a Europe-wide sensation: a composer in his twenties, taking a neglected instrument and writing for it with unprecedented imagination and power.

programme.title: Schubert - Four Impromptus, Op. 90: - I.
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Bach - Partita for Violin No. 2 (BWV 1004)
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs J. S. Bach’s Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004). The work is part of the composer’s well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Partita No. 2 is made up of four dance movements, concluded by its famous Chaconne, a monumental piece within the violin repertoire.

programme.title: Fantasymphony - One Concert to Rule Them All
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra opens the door to a wealth of fantasy universes in this mesmerizing concert program.

programme.title: Haydn - Symphony No. 45 'Farewell'
programme.desc: Under the direction of Conrad van Alphen, the Sinfonia Rotterdam Orchestra performs Haydn's Symphony No. 45 at the Nieuwe Kerk (New Church) in The Hague. This piece is nicknamed 'Farewell' because of a funny anecdote. Haydn and his musicians stayed every year from May to October at the magnificent Esterháazy Palace, at the request of Prince Nicholas.

programme.title: Luisi conducts Paganini's Violin Concerto And Brahms
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of two great works. Paganini’s Violin Concerto No. 1. is paired with Brahms’ dramatic symphonic debut, Symphony No.1. Paganini’s concerto dates from the mid-to-late 1810s, written as the composer was touring Italy with his remarkable violin technique.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Ludwig Wicki leads the Danish National Symphony Orchestra and the DR Junior Choir in a sparkling concert program of film music. The program features a selection of music from great and Oscar-winning Hollywood films, including Titanic, The Bodyguard, Pirates of the Caribbean, Braveheart, and Moulin Rouge, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, James Horner, and Klaus Badelt.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 2, Op. 17
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival.

programme.title: Preludes - Danze al pianoforte
programme.desc: In multidisciplinary project ‘Preludes - Danze al pianoforte’, dance and music come together in a wonderful and sophisticated show. Recognized Italian choreographer Massimo Moricone choreographed some of the most beautiful piano pieces by Frédéric Chopin, Claude Debussy, J. S. Bach, and Sergei Rachmaninoff, played by Italian pianist Costanza Principe.

programme.title: Nine Symphonies That Changed the World
programme.desc: Founded by Daniel Barenboim and Edward Said, the West-Eastern Divan Orchestra is composed of young musicians from Israel, Palestine, several other Arab countries, and Spain. The musicians band together at least once a year to rehearse and perform on stage, where their shared love of music crosses national, ethnic, and religious boundaries.

programme.title: Donizetti - Don Pasquale
programme.desc: Frédéric Chaslin leads the Orchestre Symphonique Région Centre-Val de Loire/Tours and the Choir of Opéra de Tours in a performance of Gaetano Donizetti’s comic opera Don Pasquale (1842). Featuring a cast of the most famous singers of the day, Don Pasquale premiered at the Parisian Salle Ventadour in 1843. It was an immediate success, being performed in the great opera houses of Europe within a year after its premiere.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Sonata No. 21 - III
programme.desc: Julijana Sarac performs the first/third movement of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Sonata No. 21 (“Waldstein”). The work was completed in 1804 and is considered one of Beethoven's greatest and most technically challenging piano sonatas.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: IVC 2019 - Final: Haydn, Schubert et al.
programme.desc: Mezzo-soprano Ema Nikolovska (Canada, 1993) and pianist Michael Sikich (United States, 1993) perform ‘The sailor’s song’ from Joseph Haydn’s Six original canzonettas, Book 2 – Hob. XXVIa; Franz Schubert’s Auf dem See, Op. 92 No. 2 (D. 543); ‘Botschaft’ from Johannes Brahms’s Fünf Lieder, Op. 47; ‘Röselein, Röselein!’ from Robert Schumann’s Sechs Gesänge, Op.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Shusha Renaissance (2023)
programme.desc: “Shusha, the Renaissance” is a musical journey featuring pianist Murad Huseynov. The city of Shusha is often considered the cradle of Azerbaijan's music and poetry and one of the leading centres of the Azerbaijani culture, having been declared the cultural capital of Azerbaijan in January 2021. On the program are the following works: Fikret Amirov’s (1922-1984) Twelve Miniatures for Piano Solo: I. Ballade - II. Ashigsayagi – III.

programme.title: Bach - Partita No. 2 and Sonata No. 3
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs two of J. S. Bach’s incredible works for solo violin: Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004), and Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005). Both works are part of the composer’s well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Partita No. 2 is made up of four dance movements, concluded by its famous Chaconne, a monumental piece within the violin repertoire.

programme.title: Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète
programme.desc: The documentary “Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète” (2017) tells the remarkable life story of Romanian pianist Clara Haskil (1895-1960). Born in Bucharest into a Jewish family, she began her career as a child prodigy, entering the Bucharest Conservatory at a very young age. She continued her music studies in Vienna and Paris. Haskil suffered from chronic health issues and lived through two world wars, which held back her career.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Sonata No. 13, KV 333
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Modena - The Belcanto School
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Beethoven Egmont Overture And Tchaikovsky Symphony 4
programme.desc: Experience a concert of high drama as conductor Nicolás Pasquet leads the Freixenet Symphony Orchestra of the Reina Sofía School of Music. The program opens with the heroic power of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Overture to Egmont, Op. 84. The concert culminates in a journey through fate and passion with Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s monumental Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1, Op. 15
programme.desc: At the age of seven, Martha Argerich made her debut with Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 1, a piece that would accompany her throughout her career. In this concert at the Lucerne Festival, the celebrated pianist performs the signature piece with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra under the baton of Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt, who made his debut here with the orchestra.

programme.title: Roberto Giordano plays Brahms and Beethoven
programme.desc: In this recital, Roberto Giordano plays the Six Pieces for Piano, op. 118 of Brahms, a collection completed in 1893 and dedicated to Clara Schumann who will be the penultimate produced by the composer during his lifetime. The concert program also includes two Beethoven sonatas, the famous Moonlight Sonata No. 14, op. 27, and Sonata No. 31, op. 110, one of the last sonatas signed by the composer.

programme.title: Bach - Preludes and Fugues And Alla variata BWV 989
programme.desc: At the age of eleven, Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti (*1977) debuted with Italian chamber orchestra I Solisti Veneti under the baton of Claudio Scimone. He performed on international festivals and in prestigious concert halls worldwide. Besides, he appeared with several renowned orchestras such as Lucerne Festival Strings, Camerata Salzburg, and Prague Chamber Orchestra. In this recital, Bacchetti performs works of J. S. Bach.

programme.title: Works by Beethoven and Saint-Saëns
programme.desc: In May and June 2021, Argentinian star pianist Martha Argerich celebrated her 80th birthday performing at Château de Chantilly, France. In this concert, recorded at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, Argerich is joined by three musicians who are particularly close to her heart: cellist Mischa Maisky, violinist Maxim Vengerov, and pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï.

programme.title: Veerhavenconcert 2016
programme.desc: On Saturday, August 27, 2016, OVG and Sinfonia Rotterdam presented a new Veerhavenconcert under the direction of Conrad van Alphen. As part of this annual event presented in the port of Rotterdam, the musicians perform on a floating stage, and audiences watch the show on the dock and on boats.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concertos, BWV 1046-1051
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Gershwin - Greatest Hits
programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge in a concert program dedicated to American composer George Gershwin. The program opens with Gershwin’s symphonic suite Catfish Row (arr. Steven D. Bowen) which is based upon music from his famous opera Porgy and Bess (1935). This is followed by the well-known tone poem An American in Paris (1928).

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartet No. 4, Op. 18, No. 4
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020’s Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven’s celebrated Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, “Eroica”. The sprightly Swedish conductor celebrated his 93rd birthday just one month before this performance. This remarkable performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Recursivo
programme.desc: The Mexico City Ballet (MXCB) is a contemporary ballet company made up of highly experienced international dancers, residents of Mexico City. International guest dancers help celebrate the anniversary gala of the Mexico City Ballet, featuring the fantastic works of MXCB’s resident choreographer, Yazmín Barragán.

programme.title: Berlioz - Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Hector Berlioz’s Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14. Berlioz wrote the piece of program music in 1830 while still a conservatory student.

programme.title: Beethoven - Septet in E-flat major, Op. 20
programme.desc: The soloists from the Lucerne Festival Orchestra present Ludwig van Beethoven’s Septet in E-flat major, Op. 20, which is scored for clarinet, horn, bassoon, violin, viola, cello and double bass. This 1799 piece achieved great popularity during Beethoven’s lifetime.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Dvorák – Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 1–8)
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Antonín Dvorák’s spirited Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 1-8). These 16 folk dances earned Dvorák, who was a relative newcomer when he wrote them, great success. Originally composed for piano four hands, the London Symphony Orchestra plays the orchestral version of these brilliant works. This performance was recorded at LSO St.

programme.title: Sinfonía por el Perú from Philharmonie de Paris
programme.desc: Superstar tenor Juan Diego Flórez brings to life the most iconic roles of the bel canto repertoire, joined by the vibrant young musicians of Sinfonía por el Perú, led by the celebrated conductor Ana María Patiño-Osorio!

programme.title: Hans van Manen – Moving to Music
programme.desc: Dutch choreographer Hans van Manen (1932) is internationally recognized as one of the grand masters of contemporary ballet. His over 150 ballets all bear his distinct signature, featuring a great clarity in structure, refined simplicity and an aversion to decorative frills.

programme.title: Mariken in the Garden of Earthly Delights
programme.desc: The opera ‘Mariken in the Garden of Earthly Delights,’ to music by Calliope Tsoupaki, is based on the miracle play 'Mariken van Nieumeghen' (c. 1515). Over five centuries, this old story hasn’t lost a bit of its power and is unquestionably part of the canon of Dutch culture. In this opera, we follow the curious but vulnerable Mariken on a journey through a dark world.

programme.title: Margarida Pinto Correia, Conversa Com… Ilda Vaz
programme.desc: Conversas simples em que cada host convida o seu mundo de pessoas. Cada dia da semana um apresentador diferente e cada um define o seu conceito e escolhe os protagonistas em função do mesmo. De 2ª a 6ª Feira às 23h, uma conversa sempre diferente. Esta semana, Margarida Pinto Correia, CONVERSA COM... ILDA VAZ. A sua infância parece relato de escravatura. Os anos 90 em Portugal deram-lhe cenas de racismo que pareciam do seculo passado.

programme.title: Feira Semanal: Viseu
programme.desc: Viseu é terra de feira e cidade com coração de aldeia. A Feira é um mundo inteiro que se abre todas as terças e sábados como um livro popular escrito a pregão aberto. Aqui, vende-se o que se planta, cria, o que se sonha. Compra-se com olhos, com palavras e com alma.

programme.desc: 'Minha Terra, Minha Gente' apresenta o melhor dos 308 concelhos do território, através da tradição, da inovação e da sustentabilidade. São empolgantes histórias de vida que personificam o amor à terra. Memórias das pessoas e dos locais, para as gerações futuras, com testemunhos marcantes e inspiradores de gente apaixonada: usos, costumes e tradições do rico património de Portugal.

programme.title: A Letra: António M. Ribeiro - 'Ucrânia Livre'
programme.desc: Num formato intimista de 11 minutos, o programa acompanha Margarida Pinto Correia em conversas próximas com músicos, centradas nas canções. 'Ucrânia Livre' foi um reviver de uma canção de protesto, que já tinha sido escrita pelos UHF para Sarajevo. António Manuel Ribeiro conta como não aguentou ver a Ucrânia a ser ataca e quis insurgir-se na poesia contra a invasão russa.

programme.title: Crimes Gone Viral T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Dois ladrões armados aproximam-se de uma jovem para lhe roubar o carro, mas são surpreendidos quando ela lhes dá luta. Um pai monta uma armadilha para capturar um predador.

programme.title: Crimes Gone Viral T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Uns ladrões roubam um tubarão de um tanque aberto num aquário e escapam. Dois reclusos evadem-se da prisão com criatividade, escondendo-se em caixotes.

programme.title: Crimes Gone Viral T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Um ladrão tenta assaltar quatro jovens com uma arma de fogo, mas as vítimas dão luta. Um homem armado entra numa garagem, só para provar que é superior em relação a um empregado.

programme.title: Crimes Gone Viral T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Um tiroteio irrompe quando mãe e filha defendem corajosamente o seu negócio. Um homem tenta, insensatamente, roubar um instrutor de artes marciais.

programme.title: Aventura À Flor Da Pele XL T8 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Jake e Waz enfrentam água gelada para construir uma barragem. Gabby arrisca-se a ter hipotermia. Jermaine e Sarah entram em conflito sobre estratégias de sobrevivência.

programme.title: Aventura À Flor Da Pele XL T8 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Um nevão durante a noite testa a energia dos sobreviventes, levando a uma alteração na liderança. Os problemas cardíacos colocam os desafios de Sarah e Joe em risco.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection T6 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Joe e a equipa deram os toques finais na carrinha Chevy 3100 de 51, transformando-a com o propósito de circular no desfile de Natal.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection T6 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Joe despede-se do seu premiado Pontiac Catalina de 65 para lhe dar a vida nova que merece: novos travões, chassis e um motor LSA 600-hp maior e mais potente.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T4 - Ep. 52
programme.desc: Se alguma vez se perguntou 'de onde é que isto veio?' ou 'como é que se faz?' Este programa é para si. Pegamos em objetos do quotidiano e mostramos-lhe 'O Segredo das Coisas'.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T7 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Viaje aos bastidores para saber como objetos do quotidiano são produzidos. Descubra como mastros de fibra de carbono, bolinhos da sorte e projetores IMAX são feitos.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T11 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Os mineiros do ouro de Yukon arriscam tudo na esperança de enriquecerem da noite para o dia. Com mineiros, reivindicações e máquinas novas, os riscos nunca foram tão grandes!

programme.title: Aquários XXL T7 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Anthony Davis, estrela da NBA, pede a Wayne e Brett que transforme uma divisão inteira num aquário! Conseguirão os rapazes entregar um tanque vencedor?

programme.title: Aquários XXL T7 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: Antonio Brown, estrela da NFL, acha que um aquário o levará à Super Bowl deste ano. ATM tem que o impressionar com uma gigantesco aquário e com uma dança!

programme.title: À Pesca De Ouro T10 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Shawn pesa o ouro da primeira viagem da temporada do Myrtle Irene. Será que satisfaz as suas expectativas? Enquanto isso, o irmão de Zeke retorna ao mergulho.

programme.title: À Pesca De Ouro T10 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Está em curso uma corrida ao ouro, mas este metal precioso foi encontrado no fundo do Mar de Bering. Há uma meia dúzia de pessoas disposta a arriscar tudo para o trazer à tona.

programme.title: À Pesca De Ouro T10 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: Está em curso uma corrida ao ouro, mas este metal precioso foi encontrado no fundo do Mar de Bering. Há uma meia dúzia de pessoas disposta a arriscar tudo para o trazer à tona.

programme.desc: Está em curso uma corrida ao ouro, mas este metal precioso foi encontrado no fundo do Mar de Bering. Há uma meia dúzia de pessoas disposta a arriscar tudo para o trazer à tona.

programme.title: Expedição X T3 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Jess e Phil vão às profundezas das Ozarks para investigar uma fera predadora. Novas gravações de uivos levam a uma revelação chocante.

programme.title: Expedição X T3 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Phil e Jess procuram em rápidos e num lago gelado do Alasca um animal lendário que agora é alvo de uma investigação científica séria.

programme.title: Expedição X T3 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: No local da avalanche mais fatal da América, testemunhas relatam aparições bizarras e pavor. Phil e Jess testam uma teoria científica surpreendente.

programme.desc: Viaje aos bastidores para saber como objetos do quotidiano são produzidos. Descubra como os capacetes dos bombeiros, as bússolas e os serrotes são feitos.

programme.desc: Viaje aos bastidores para saber como objetos do quotidiano são produzidos. Descubra como as lâmpadas de halogénio, isolante de celulose e canas de pesca de bambú são feitos.

programme.desc: Viaje aos bastidores para saber como objetos do quotidiano são produzidos. Descubra o que é preciso para fazer brocas, cabines de fotografia e selos.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T7 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Viaje aos bastidores para saber como objetos do quotidiano são produzidos. Descubra como os lemes, tapetes entrelaçados e termóstatos automóveis são feitos.

programme.title: Caçadores De Pedras Preciosas T8 - Ep. 17
programme.desc: Os Opal Lovers escavam velhos caminhos à procura de opalas de cristal vermelho. Os problemas mecânicos voltam a dar dores de cabeça aos Mooka Boys.

programme.title: Caçadores De Pedras Preciosas: Austrália T3 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Ray e Paul vão ao local onde retiraram uma enorme rocha para ver se há pedras preciosas. Matt e Amber, recém-chegados a Gemfields, procuram safiras.

programme.title: Joias Sobre Rodas T15 - Ep. 27
programme.desc: Ant é desafiado para trabalhar no Porsche 911 SC de 1982 de Mike. O duo revê os seus disparates e momentos nunca antes vistos.

programme.title: Joias Sobre Rodas T16 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Mike Brewer, negociante de carros, e Ant Anstead, multitalentoso mecânico, têm a missão de encontrar e restaurar carros icónicos para depois os vender na sua oficina de LA.

programme.title: Shed And Buried T4 - Ep. 18
programme.desc: Numa quinta em Gloucester, Henry e Fuzz veem uma coleção de tratores. Acham objetos históricos das décadas de 1910 e 1920. Será possível restaurá-los?

programme.title: Shed And Buried T4 - Ep. 19
programme.desc: O apresentador Henry Cole e o mecânico Fuzz Townshend vão em viagem para achar, comprar e rentabilizar automóveis abandonados do Reino Unido.

programme.desc: O apresentador Henry Cole e o mecânico Fuzz Townshend vão em viagem para achar, comprar e rentabilizar automóveis abandonados do Reino Unido.

programme.title: Os Últimos Lenhadores T2 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Dois furos deixam o Fat Truck de Alicia imobilizado e a exploração para. Com a primeira barcaça a chegar, a tripulação corre para retomar a produção.

programme.title: Regresso Às Origens T4 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: No Havai, os Raneys resgatam uma jovem família com uma cabana a desmoronar-se numa propriedade infestada de lesmas portadoras de parasitas que infetam o cérebro humano.

programme.title: A Minha Família Vive No Alasca T4 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Os Wolfpack chegam à sua nova propriedade na zona mais remota dos EUA. Mas o longo inverno cria o caos na tentativa da família assentar.

programme.title: Aventura À Flor Da Pele XL T8 - Ep. 5

programme.title: Aventura À Flor Da Pele XL T8 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: O ataque de um urso pardo leva a uma assustadora missão de busca e salvamento. Montana ataca com uma ventania feroz na noite anterior à extração.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 71
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 33
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 14
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 91
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 92
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: Christian Scott - The Centennial Trilogy
programme.desc: In just a few years, young trumpet player Christian Scott has become synonymous with a new jazz generation. He shakes up the conventions of jazz by taking the genre to new horizons and reaching a wider audience. No doubt, at 33 years old, Christian Scott is already forging his own path. After each record release, he seems even more determined to challenge the rules of jazz with his own avant-garde style.

programme.title: MPB Sessions - Pedro Viáfora And Celso Viáfora
programme.desc: Pedro Viáfora and Celso Viáfora are a father-and-son duo that brings together different generations of Brazilian music. Celso is a renowned composer with an extensive discography, while Pedro began his career with the group 5 a Seco before developing his solo work.

programme.title: Liz McComb in Paris: Back to Blues
programme.desc: This film is a souvenir of an extraordinary concert. It reveals the true personality of Liz Mc Comb: more than a great gospel singer, she is a lover who dreams of sharing her generosity with us. Liz Mc Comb sings, among others, 'I'm Just a Poor Wayfaring Stranger' for all the immigrants in the world, followed by her famous 'Time Is Now'.

programme.title: On The Road With Duke Ellington: II
programme.desc: In May 2014, the Conservatory of Amsterdam hosted a unique conference about one of the greatest jazz composers of the 20th century: Duke Ellington. Musicologists and musicians with a special bond with Ellington and his music spoke about his life and music. Among them were David Schiff, author of ‘The Ellington Century’, and Harvey Cohen, author of ‘Duke Ellington’s America’.

programme.title: STUFF. live at BIRD Rotterdam
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s BIRD is a club, café, and restaurant with a live music program that's deeply rooted in jazz, soul, funk, hip-hop, and electronic. Its name BIRD refers to the nickname of legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker. BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, fine wines, no-nonsense beers, and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ.

programme.title: Tribute to Gilberto Gil - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The series Da Pá Virada sessions presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is Caixa Cubo.

programme.title: In pursuit of the 27th man
programme.desc: Legendary jazz pianist Horace Silver's groundbreaking fusion of hard bop, blues, soulful grooves and Cape Verdean influences have left an indelible mark on the world of jazz. At the renowned Umbria Jazz Festival in the picturesque region of Umbria, Italy, Silver is accompanied by a great band of future all-stars: Bob Berg on tenor sax, Tom Harrell on trumpet, Steve Beskrone on bass and Eddie Gladden on drums.

programme.title: Con Alma
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan Live in '58 And 64: The Divine One
programme.desc: Sarah Vaughan: Live in '58 And 64 features the ‘Divine One’ in her prime, wrapping her sultry voice around jazz standards such as ‘Lover Man’, ‘Misty’ and ‘I Got Rhythm’ and soaring on popular showtunes such as ‘Over The Rainbow’ and ‘Maria’. One of the greatest voices of the 20th Century, her renditions of songs by Harold Arlen, Leonard Bernstein, Johnny Burke, the Gershwins and Stephen Sondheim are pure diva magic.

programme.title: George Shearing: The South Bank Show
programme.desc: George Shearing, blind since birth, is one of the world's greatest jazz pianists. Filmed on both sides of the Atlantic, this tribute to Shearing showcases the music which took the jazz world by storm.

programme.title: Jazz de Matosinhos and Sinfónica do Porto: Layas
programme.desc: 30 minutes of... Orquestra Jazz de Matosinhos and Orquestra Sinfónica do Porto Casa da Música conducted by Dirk Brossé. Casa da Música is a performance hall located in Porto, in northern Portugal. Brossé, born in Ghent, Belgium in 1960, is a versatile composer and a respected conductor on the international music scene. Pianist Jason Moran and cellist J.A. Pereira de Sousa accompany both sets.

programme.title: Panorama do Choro - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is Panorama de Coro. This ensemble combines jazz and traditional Brazilian music.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Baptiste Trontignon
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Mondriaan Jazz 2017: FORQ
programme.desc: Forq is an instrumental quartet with an aggressive sound and a penchant for sonic exploration. Originally founded by keyboardist?Henry Hey?(David Bowie, Empire of the Sun, and Jeff 'Tain' Watts) and bassist?Michael League?(Grammy-winning founder of Snarky Puppy), Forq is joined by guitarist?Chris McQueen?and drummer?Jason 'JT' Thomas.

programme.title: Franco Ambrosetti Quintet live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The composer, trumpeter and bugle player Franco Ambrosetti performs with his quintet in his native Lugano as part of the Estival.

programme.title: The Streets of London: Jazz in The City
programme.desc: Short Documentary about Jazz in The City: London.

programme.title: Mont Saint-Michel: Steve Grossman And Peter King
programme.desc: Every year, the Jazz en Baie festival takes place in the beautiful bay of Mont Saint-Michel. Today’s broadcast shows a special gathering between saxophone heavyweights Peter King and Steve Grossman. These experienced musicians’ trip to the bay amounts to much more than a social call. The quintet, which is rounded out by bass player Duylinh N'Guyen, drummer Stéphane Huchard and pianist Alain Jean-Marie, delivers an amazing show.

programme.title: John Lewis: Piano Solo
programme.desc: Pianist John Lewis, co-founder and long-time leader of the legendary Modern Jazz Quartet, wrote jazz history with that band. His ability to blend classical forms with jazz improvisations singled him out as a unique artist, who was capable of transcending every musical barrier. When the Modern Jazz Quartet retired, John Lewis continued to work with other musicians and as a solo pianist.

programme.title: Roy Hargrove Quintet
programme.desc: Emblematic trumpeter of the second wave of 'neo-boppers' that appeared at the end of the 80s in the wake of Wynton Marsalis, Roy Hargrove has established himself as one of the most talented and unpredictable of the lot.

programme.title: Mestrinho - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: Da Pá Virada sessions bring the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: Episode 5: Chet Baker - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American trumpet player and occasional singer Chet Baker (1929-1988) was one of the most popular exponents of bebop and cool jazz. At the age of 10, Baker was introduced to music in a school orchestra, after which he discovered bebop in the army in 1946. After serving six months in prison in 1953 for drug possession, Baker formed his own quartet with West Coast jazz great, pianist Russ Freeman.

programme.title: Episode 6: Herbie Hancock - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American keyboard player and bandleader Herbie Hancock (1940) achieved success as an incisive, harmonically provocative jazz pianist in the 1960s, then went on to gain wide popularity as a leader of electric jazz-rock groups. One of these, Hancock’s band The Headhunters, ushered in a new era of jazz that appealed to a far wider audience, making jazz listeners out of rhythm and blues fans, and vice versa.

programme.title: Joe Zawinul - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. In 1985, Viennese keyboardist Joe Zawinul was one of the artists appearing at this festival.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: BIRD - The Nest
programme.desc: Five promising musicians get together in Rotterdam jazz club BIRD’s artists-in-residence project “The Nest”. Over the course of seven sessions, these talents exchange ideas, work on their projects, and play music together. Following this period, during which record producer Jameszoo and music manager Jochem Tromp offer their coaching experience, BIRD and North Sea Jazz Festival’s fringe festival DownTown organize a tryout performance.

programme.title: People Time
programme.desc: Regarded as the greatest instrumental soloist of all-time, Stanley Gayetzky, famously known as Stan Getz emerged as one of the most significant musical forces in the world of jazz post World War II. With his distinctively warm and lyrical tone, Getz is fondly dubbed as ‘The Sound’ because of his singularity and musical innovations.

programme.title: Jimmy Witherspoon Quartet And Rozaa Wortham 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Jimmy Witherspoon and Rozaa Wortham, two incredible brilliant jazz musicians. Rozaa Wortham starts off the show with the Jimmy Witherspoon Quartet.

programme.title: Dee Dee Bridgewater: Motherland
programme.desc: Singer Dee Dee Bridgewater walks in with considerable credentials, but this documentary related to her album ‘Red Earth’ trumps them all: Red Earth is a Malian journey that merges and melts all borders. While world-beat listeners will recognize the grooves, this is Bridgewater's first time bringing her own experiences as an African-American woman back to the motherland. It results in a fusion of feeling, visions, and music.

programme.title: F.B. Orch., B.E. Ba., T.J. and M.L. Ba. - Newport
programme.desc: In 1968 traden het orkest van de Belgische pianist Francy Boland, de band van de Nederlandse trompettist Boy Edgar en de Amerikaanse band van trompettist Thad Jones en drummer Mel Lewis op tijdens het Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam.

programme.title: Brussels Jazz Orchestra: Changing Faces
programme.desc: This might come unexpected, but the Brussels Jazz Orchestra (BJO) is not the kind of jazz orchestra that sticks to standards. They prefer to achieve the highest level by composing original music, creating unique arrangements, and playing inventively as well as passionately. In fact, it really is jazz with a dynamic orchestral sound, with a classic strength in which each musician is also a brilliant soloist.

programme.title: Wynton Marsalis Quintet - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, American trumpeter and composer Wynton Marsalis and his quintet performed at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Donna lee
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world.

programme.title: Billie Holiday
programme.desc: “God Bless The Child”, “Foolin’ Myself”, and “I Loves You, Porgy”: timeless songs that were made classics by the inimitable Billie Holiday. ‘Lady Day’, as her loyal friend and musical partner Lester Young nicknamed her, was a highly original jazz and pop singer. In a career that spanned most of the 1930s, 1940s and 1950s, she displayed an uncanny ability to convey emotion through her voice.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Anita Oday Live in Sweden 1963
programme.desc: Anita O’Day?boasts two wonderful concerts from 1963 and 1970 that present the “jazz singer supreme” in impeccable form. O’Day’s horn-based approach to singing is in full effect throughout both shows including stand-out renditions in each show of audience favorites “Tea For Two” and “Sweet Georgia Brown” (both reprised from her triumphant appearance at the 1958 Newport Jazz Festival.

programme.title: Chamber music: Sissoko And Segal
programme.desc: Hailing from a long tradition of Malian kora players, Ballake Sissoko has worked with renowned musicians such as Toumani Diabaté and Taj Mahal. He met the French born Vincent Ségal by chance, and the two began jamming together, uncertain of what kind of music might result.

programme.title: Bobby McFerrin - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In 1985, American vocal virtuoso Bobby McFerrin took the stage solo at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: Joe Turner - Jazz Marmalade
programme.desc: This vintage program, ‘Jazz Marmalade’, shows expatriate American musicians plying their trade in two Parisian jazz clubs in 1962. First, American stride pianist Joe Turner (often confused with blues shouter ‘Big’ Joe Turner) opens this atmospheric broadcast with a swinging piano-bass duet recorded at the Mars Club. Joe Turner (1907–1990) would remain in Paris for the rest of his life.

programme.title: Scott DuBois Quartet Live In Munich
programme.desc: Rising star of the jazz guitar Scott DuBois leads his quartet, consisting of Gebhard Ullmann (reeds), Thomas Morgan (bass), and Kresten Osgood (drums), in an intimate and atmospheric performance at Munich’s Jazz Club Unterfahrt in March 2016. The group’s telepathy is such that they are able to go from deathly quiet to fiercely avant-garde at the drop of a hat.

programme.title: Erroll Garner - Live in Singer Concertzaal, Laren
programme.desc: On June 18, 1962, American pianist and composer Erroll Garner performed at the Singer Concertzaal in Laren. The vibrant and joyous concert was played with drummer Kelly Martin and bassist Eddie Calhoun, each long-standing collaborators from Garner's trio. The Singer Concertzaal in Laren, the Netherlands is a concert hall and museum dedicated to the preservation of the art collection of American William Henry Singer.

programme.title: Aki Rissanen Trio at Jazzclub Unterfahrt, Munich
programme.desc: Aki Rissanen's interest in jazz came after he started taking classical piano lessons. His deep interest in improvised music placed him among top jazz pianist in his home country - Finland. While composing and performing his own music, Rissanen has also collaborated with Verneri Pohjola and Dave Liebman, and today his name appears among the top European jazz musicians.

programme.title: Burton Greene - OTO Part III
programme.desc: Legendary free jazz pianist Burton Greene rose to fame in New York City's free jazz scene of the 1960s. Exploring various spontaneous improvisational styles, Greene performs live at Cafe OTO in London, UK.

programme.title: The Skymasters with Clark Terry - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1989, Dutch big band and radio orchestra The Skymasters took flight at the North Sea Jazz Festival in the Hague.

programme.title: Seun Kuti And Egypt 80 - Cabaret Sauvage
programme.desc: Seun Anikulapo Kuti possesses the grace, energy and fury of his father, the legendary artist Fela Kuti. With the musicians of Fela Kuti’s legendary band Egypt 80, Seaun Kuti brings the most original incarnation of Afrobeat to life. Digging deep into different African traditions, Seun has brought his own touch to the music by reflecting the difficulties and cultures of the continent.

programme.title: Coleman 'Hank' Hawkins: Belgium 1962
programme.desc: Coleman Hawkins: Live in '62 presents two incredible concerts featuring stellar European and American legendary side-musicians including Harry ‘Sweets’ Edison on trumpet and drummer ‘Papa’ Jo Jones. Coleman Hawkins, ‘The Father of Jazz Saxophone,’ demonstrates why he is still considered one of the most important innovators in the history of jazz.

programme.title: Sammy Price and his All Star Orchestra
programme.desc: Texan pianist Sammy Price (1908-1992) played everything from blues and boogie-woogie to swing and jump-blues. Starting in Dallas as a singer and dancer in Alphonso Trent’s orchestra, he went to Kansas to form the Texas Bluesicians. At the end of the 1930s, and as a house pianist for the Decca label, he backed many stars, including Sister Rosetta Tharpe and Trixie Smith.

programme.title: Jacques Kuba Séguin: L'étude des Lueurs
programme.desc: Trumpeter Jacques Kuba Séguin’s ensemble unites some of Montreal’s most expressive musicians: apart from Jacques Kuba Séguin, double bassist Frédéric Alarie, pianist Jonathan Cayer, and drummer Kevin Warren deliver subtle but strong lyrical moments, that make it hard not to be touched by the musical bond of this group. The experience of their ‘Litania Projekt’ seems to stop time for an instant.

programme.title: Jungle By Night - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned bands. In 2019, one of them is the Amsterdam-based Dutch instrumental collective Jungle by Night. The band plays a mix of various styles, inspired by funk, jazz, dub, rock, and others. The ensemble made its debut in 2010 and has played at numerous festivals.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets And Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Episode 3: Miles Davis - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell’Arte in Milan.

programme.title: McCoy Tyner Trio live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. McCoy Tyner’s first main exposure came with Benny Golson, being the first pianist in Golson’s and Art Farmer’s Jazztet.

programme.title: Count Basie - North Sea Jazz Part I
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: S. Quintet, Hubbard And Henderson - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Final Step Live @ Il Magazzino: Three Sails
programme.desc: From the polyglot border region of Ticino in Switzerland – well-known for its beautiful Lake Maggiore and the International Film Festival in Locarno – comes ‘Final Step’, guitarist Matteo Finali’s seven-piece band. 'Live @ Il Magazzino' is the band’s third album since its formation in 2003. The diverse musical backgrounds of the various band members shine through on the album: it is a fusion of jazz, rock, funk, blues and ethnic music.

programme.title: Schloss Ansbach: Ornette Coleman Sextet
programme.desc: ‘Harmolodics’, the musical philosophy of jazz saxophonist Ornette Coleman, is associated primarily with avant-garde jazz and the free jazz movement, although its implications extend beyond these limits. Coleman defined ‘harmolodics’ as “the use of the physical and the mental of one's own logic made into an expression of sound to bring about the musical sensation of unison executed by a single person or with a group”.

programme.title: The Jackson Singers
programme.desc: The American gospel group The Jackson Singers, founded by Bob Jackson in 1980, found a warm welcome in Europe, where they have toured for decades. Embraced for their powerful spirituals and gospel music, they have become a celebrated presence in churches, cathedrals, and jazz festivals across the continent.

programme.title: Capitaine Marleau
programme.desc: Joseph Nyandoro, un ex-Président africain, vit en exil dans un village français. Josselin Gramont, un maraîcher, est retrouvé mort, tué par arme à feu. Marleau découvre que la victime et le Président s'étaient liés d'amitié. Cette amitié lui aurait-elle coûté la vie ? Nyandoro envisageait de s'installer définitivement dans ce village, mais la belle Inissa, son éminence grise, le poussait à reconquérir le pouvoir en Afrique.

programme.title: Ça Commence aujourd'hui
programme.desc: Tous les jours, Faustine BOLLAERT accueille sur le plateau de « Ca commence aujourd’hui » des hommes et des femmes qui viennent témoigner sur une période de leur vie, un drame, une épreuve, un cap à passer ou un changement, et qui font souvent écho à de grands sujets de société. Entourée d'experts : psychologues, psychiatres, avocats, gynécologue, Faustine aide les témoins et les téléspectateurs à mieux comprendre ce qu’ils ont vécu.

programme.title: Les Joyaux des Mers du Sud

Franck Tehaamatai, un des plus importants perliculteurs de Polynésie, a bien voulu ouvrir toutes grandes les portes du lagon afin de partager sa passion des perles.

Une série documentaire produite par Bo Travail !, avec la participation de France Télévisions. Le Finistère est une terre où tout semble commencer… ou s'arrêter. À l'extrémité de la Bretagne, Ismaël Khelifa part à la découverte de ce bout du monde façonné par les vents, les marées et une nature restée sauvage.

programme.title: Echappées Belles
programme.desc: Présentation : Ismaël Khelifa. Réalisation : Jeremi Nureni Banafunzi, Agnès Vanhems-Dufoix et Sophie Planque. programme.title: A la Decouverte du Monde
programme.desc: Série documentaire produite par Media 9. 2024. Un film de Pierre Brouwers. Immense et très peu peuplé, le plus grand des états américains est le pays aux 100.000 glaciers, qui recouvrent 5 % de son territoire. Vus du ciel, les géants de glace sont d'une beauté inouïe, et lorsqu'on les découvre à l'aide de traîneaux à chiens ou en s'y posant en avions à ski, l'aventure réserve bien des surprises.

programme.title: Pierre Boulez Dirige Stravinsky - l'oiseau de Feu au louvre
programme.desc: Co-production: Idéale Audience And le Musée du Louvre Réalisation: Andy Sommer Capté au Musée du Louvre de Paris en décembre 2008 Le compositeur et chef d’orchestre Pierre Boulez est particulièrement connu pour ses interprétations raffinées des classiques du XXe siècle en général et de Stravinsky en particulier.

programme.title: Des Trains pas comme les Autres
programme.desc: Série documentaire produite par Step by Step Productions, avec la participation de France Télévisions et de Ushuaïa TV. 2022. Auteurs : Philippe Gougler, Alex Badin Réalisation et mise en images : Alex Badin Avec Philippe Gougler Cette série invite le téléspectateur à découvrir un pays et sa culture à travers un parcours toujours pittoresque sur les lignes ferroviaires nationales.

programme.title: Vivre Loin du Monde
programme.desc: Série documentaire coproduite par Renegade Pictures/GroupM Motion Entertainment Ltd. 2023. Réalisation : Dimitri Collingridge. Ben Fogle part à la rencontre de personnes ayant décidé d'habiter dans des endroits retirés, partout dans le monde. La complicité qui se crée entre les hôtes et leur invité permet de comprendre leur cheminement.

programme.title: Nos très chers Animaux
programme.desc: Documentaire produit par Antipode avec la participation de France Télévisions. 2024. Un film de Hermine Costa et Ulysse Cailloux Aujourd’hui, un Français sur deux possède un animal de compagnie, avec en tête environ 15 millions de chats et 8 millions de chiens, des membres de la famille à part entière. Le marché est estimé en France à environ 5,8 milliards d’euros, soit plus que celui des jeux vidéo.

programme.title: De Gaulle, la Bombe à tout Prix!
programme.desc: Documentaire coproduit par Mérapi Productions/ECPAD, avec la participation de France Télévisions. 2025. Un film de Lionel Boisseau. Conseiller historique : Jean-Marc Regnault. Entre le premier essai en 1966 à Mururoa et la première explosion de la bombe H en 1968 sur l’atoll de Fangataufa en Polynésie, la France devient une puissance thermonucléaire. Leurs conséquences ont été bien souvent documentées mais que s’est-il passé avant ?

programme.title: Réflexe!
programme.desc: Réflexe!

programme.title: C Politique
programme.desc: Chaque dimanche, Thomas Snégaroff accueille les téléspectateurs pour décrypter l'actualité et nous raconter l'époque ! Autour de lui, Blanche Leridon, essayiste et directrice éditoriale de l'institut Montaigne, et Raphaël Llorca, expert associé à la Fondation Jean-Jaurès, nous raconteront les aspirations, les craintes mais aussi les espoirs des Françaises et des Français durant cette campagne présidentielle historique.

programme.title: C Politique la Suite
programme.desc: Présenté par Thomas Snégaroff, nous profitons d’un véritable forum de discussion où les points de vue s'expriment, se confrontent et s'enrichissent. Face aux questions marquantes qui traversent notre époque, l'émission offre un espace d'analyse et d'échange entre experts, citoyens et philosophes. L’objectif : décrypter les grands sujets contemporains afin de nous aider à mieux les comprendre.

programme.title: En Tension
programme.desc: Réalisateur : FC Guiro Écrit par : FC Guiro, Yohan Malka et Hugo Travers Production : France Télévisions, Unfold, Main originals, HDMEDIA Produit par : Aubin Talbi Avec : HugoDécrypte Hugo Travers, fondateur d’HugoDécrypte, se rend sur le terrain pour comprendre les grands bouleversements mondiaux, à la rencontre de jeunes de sa génération, au cœur de ces fractures.

programme.title: Aux Origines des Terrorismes
programme.desc: Une série documentaire écrite et réalisée par Serge July avec Alain Bauer produite par JEM Production, avec la participation de France Télévisions Le terrorisme fait chaque année des milliers de morts dans le monde, des morts connus et inconnus. Dans l’Antiquité, au Moyen Âge, à une époque où le mot terrorisme n’existait pas, on faisait déjà un usage démesuré de la terreur, à fortiori avec les guerres de religion.

programme.title: Rwanda, Désobéir ou laisser Mourir?
programme.desc: Documentaire coproduit par Palmyra Films/Effervescence Doc, avec la participation de France Télévisions. Auteur : Joël Kotek. Réalisatrice : Valérie Inizan. Avec la voix de Sonia Rolland. Conseillère historique : Hélène Dumas.

programme.title: L'oeil And la Main
programme.desc: Un film de Frederic Schneider Producteur délégué : Manuel Catteau Producteurs exécutifs : Hélène Hugounenq, Laurent Valo Collection documentaire produite par ZED, avec la participation de France Télévisions, du Centre National du Cinéma et de l’image animée, et le soutien de l’AGEFIPH. 2026.

programme.title: Mécaniques du Journalisme
programme.desc: Réalisation : Vincent de Cointet Production : Jaraprod et Taleseed avec la participation de France Télévisions. 2026 Chaque épisode de 'Mécaniques du Journalisme' s’attache à comprendre comment une enquête journalistique a fait basculer le cours de l’histoire récente.

programme.title: Mao, le dernier Empereur
programme.desc: Auteur et réalisateur : Serge de Sampigny Un documentaire en deux parties produit par Histodoc, avec la participation de France Télévisions. 2026 Mao Zedong est mort il y a 50 ans, le 9 septembre 1976. Selon les historiens, il est responsable de la mort de plus de 60 millions de personnes, soit environ 10% de la population chinoise de son temps.

programme.title: Falas Da Vida: Quantos Dias. Quantas Noites
programme.desc: Estudos dizem que o humano que vai viver 150 anos já nasceu. Mas o que estamos de fato fazendo com essa oportunidade? “Quantos dias. Quantas noites”, novo documentário da Maria Farinha Filmes (“Aruanas”, “Começo da Vida”) dirigido por Cacau Rhoden (“Nunca Me Sonharam”, “Tarja Branca”), realiza um profundo mergulho nos propósitos da nossa existência no planeta.

programme.title: Globo Repórter - Ep. 1932
programme.desc: Com apresentação de William Bonner e Sandra Annenberg, o ‘Globo Repórter’ é um programa de reportagens com foco em comportamento, aventura, ciência e natureza. Apresenta destinos do mundo, além de novas pesquisas nas áreas de saúde e tecnologia.

programme.title: Alma Gêmea - Ep. 125
programme.desc: Xavier ajuda Guto. Serena se emociona ao encontrar um objeto. Romeu confessa um segredo a Generosa. Alexandra afirma que Cristina não está grávida.

programme.title: Pantanal - Ep. 47
programme.desc: Alcides revela a Juma que é filho do jagunço que matou o irmão dela, e que veio atrás de Tenório, o mesmo que enganou Gil e Maria. Dona Jacutinga entrega um dinheiro a José Lucas, para ajudá-lo na viagem sem destino. Gustavo e Nayara ficam juntos. Guta fica perplexa ao ver Maria Bruaca saindo de barco com Alcides. Maria Bruaca beija Alcides.

programme.title: Império - Ep. 173
programme.desc: Felipe ameaça matar Enrico. Enrico agride Leonardo. Maria Clara escuta a conversa da mãe com o mordomo. Enrico liga para Clara.

programme.title: Passione - Ep. 161
programme.desc: Mauro tenta descobrir o nome da empresa que comprou a maior parte das ações da metalúrgica. Clô fica frustrada por Olavo não ter conseguido comprar as ações. Fred instrui o investidor para lhe representar na metalúrgica. Felícia pede um tempo a Totó para decidir com quem quer ficar. Guida ajuda Berilo a ver Olavinho. Olavo volta para casa e se desespera ao descobrir que o neto não está. Candê reabre a sua banca no CEAGESP.

programme.title: A Nobreza do Amor - Ep. 104
programme.desc: Malungo garante a Alika que está a seu lado e de Niara, e que não revelará seu paradeiro a Jendal. Geralda sonda Belmira sobre Carrapato. Mirinho se impressiona com a postura de Manoel em relação a Ana Maria. Fátima finge passar mal para influenciar Salma a se casar com Fuad. Fortunato reprova o namoro de Manoel com Ana Maria, e Maria Helena apoia o filho.

programme.title: Orgulho e Paixão - Ep. 114
programme.desc: Lady Margareth desafia Elisabeta. Julieta convida Olegário para trabalhar para ela. Ema convence o avô a aceitar seu noivado. Otávio vê Brandão e Mário/Mariana se beijando e fica confuso. Aurélio pede que Camilo perdoe Julieta. Brandão impede Otávio de contar o que viu para Agatha. Josephine ameaça Cecília. Susana anuncia a todos que seu casamento com Darcy irá acontecer em breve.

programme.title: Por Você - Ep. 23
programme.desc: Peixe afirma a Bela que ele e seus irmãos não ficarão por muito tempo em seu prédio. Peixe sofre ao lembrar de Juli. Lucas apoia Sabugo. Gabriel e Peixe se aproximam. A armação de Vanessa dá certo, e Gabriel é convidado para palestrar em evento importante. Lucas questiona Bela sobre seus sentimentos por Gabriel. Juarez se coloca perigosamente no alto de uma passarela.

programme.title: A Gata Comeu - Ep. 29
programme.desc: Jô desmarca seu casamento com Rafael, mas uma situação inusitada na igreja mexe com a moça. Gugu e Braguinha chegam a um acordo. Jô arma plano para atrapalhar casamento de Fábio.

programme.title: A Próxima Vítima - Ep. 92
programme.desc: Quitéria descobre quem é o pai de um dos filhos de Ana. Lucas fica transtornado ao conversar com a mãe. Isabela está prestes a descobrir um segredo.

programme.title: Alma Gêmea - Ep. 125
programme.desc: Xavier ajuda Guto. Serena se emociona ao encontrar um objeto. Romeu confessa um segredo a Generosa. Alexandra afirma que Cristina não está grávida.
